rules.interpretation: Ability controller is distinct from source characteristics. Player-protection targeting uses the spell or ability controller; passing a source snapshot must not replace that controller. Aura spell targeting and an Aura source's unrelated activated ability are distinct. A returned source is a new object.

findings.fact: Caller discards original-source colors/subtypes/card types and asks PlayerProtectionRules to read present sourceId.
findings.repair: Use resolved original-visit characteristics for player-protection scopes; retain the stack object's controller for EachOpponent targeting. Do not globally alter damage semantics.
witnesses: live/removed/returned original-source color, subtype and card-type scopes
ability controller and current/source-snapshot controller differ in both directions
empty/partial known LKI must not borrow a later source visit

findings.fact: Its existing sourceSnapshot parameter replaces controller choice for EachOpponent as well as characteristic reads; blindly passing LKI would regress targeting-controller semantics.
findings.repair: Provide an explicit targeting context/override separated from damage-source controller. Add paired executable tests before using the helper in retargeting.

findings.fact: Correct original-visit selection already exists, but returned data contains only colors/subtypes/cardTypes. Snapshot already has supertypes; callers must not re-read a different visit.
findings.repair: Reuse this selection rule for the additional facts required by targeting; avoid duplicating visit inference and retain legacy fallback. Keep protected StackResolver bytes unchanged.
witnesses: original legendary source removed and returned nonlegendary

findings.fact: Present sourceId being an Aura applies an enchantment restriction even to unrelated abilities.
findings.repair: At the bounded retargeting path distinguish Aura spell from an ability whose source is an Aura. Do not change non-targeted attachment behavior.
witnesses: unrelated ability from Aura source allowed absent other restrictions

findings.fact: EntityId equality conflates original source with returned visit.
findings.repair: Carry authoritative original source reference through retargeting validation and use visit equality; retain explicit legacy behavior when no authoritative origin exists.
witnesses: same EntityId later visit eligible if remaining predicates pass
unknown original visit never silently rebound
